I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: the 2027 Thornbury Cloth Co. renewal (Bittern) is 163 seats."

A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it's fine to keep in that channel. She said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. Her message is saved in the brain automatically, like every channel message.
